system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You bind battlefields onto you. A living sigil of control or domination. The arena is yours to command.

As a Bonus Action, you can place a binding seal onto yourself, and the ground, at a point you can reach, which remains for the next minute. The sigil, releases a 120-foot radius aura centered on the point. The edges of the aura has binding chains at its perimeter.

For the duration, attacks made with the Binding Chain feature or jutsu you cast with the Fuinjutsu keyword, can target any creature within this radius, even if you cannot see them, so long as you are aware of them and they are within the radius, they can be targeted, even if behind full cover.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.
